name: inline-field
title: Inline field
description: A checkbox, switch or radio with its label beside it, plus a description and an error beneath, wired together as one tap target.
docs: Put one Checkbox, Switch or RadioGroupItem inside it. InlineField gives the control its id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, required and disabled, so the label, the description and the error are read in that order. The whole row is the click target, at least 44px high on a touch screen, the focus ring stays on the control, and a link in the label (terms, privacy) opens as a link without toggling the control. placement='end' pushes the control to the far edge, as a settings row does; invalid and disabled look the same on all three controls; a disabled row dims the control and its label and keeps the description at full strength, because that is where the reason goes.
